Description
The University of Bristol is one of Britain’s traditional research-intensive Russell Group universities. Students benefit from research-inspired teaching, world-class facilities and a community of inquisitive minds from across the globe. It is consistently ranked among the country’s best, so students graduate with a degree that’s widely respected. In fact, the University’s graduates are in high demand, with employers recognizing the enormous value of a degree from the University of Bristol. With a large community of students and young people, as well as a range of bars, restaurants, shops and cafés for you to discover, Bristol is a great place to live and study. In 2018, the National Geographic Traveller ranked Bristol number 11 on its ‘Cool List’.
